tool.name: bcftools @EXECUTABLE@

param.name: genotypes
param.label: Genotypes to compare against
param.help: (-g) Checks sample identity or when omitted a multi-sample cross-check is performed

param.name: distinctive_sites
param.label: Distinctive sites
param.help: Find sites that can distinguish between at least NUM sample pairs. Format: NUM[,MEM[,TMP]]. If the number is smaller or equal to 1, it is interpreted as the fraction of pairs.

param.label: Dry run
param.help: Stop after first record to estimate required time

param.name: error_probability
param.label: Error probability (-E)
param.help: Phred-scaled probability of genotyping error, 0 for faster but less accurate results [40]

param.name: homs_only
param.label: Homs Only (-H)
param.help: Homozygous genotypes only, useful with low coverage data (requires Genotypes input -g)

param.label: Keep refs
param.help: Keep monoallelic sites with no alternate allele

param.name: n_matches
param.label: N-matches
param.help: Print only top INT matches for each sample (sorted by average score), 0 for unlimited. Use negative value to sort by HWE probability rather than by discordance [0]

param.name: pairs
param.label: Pairs to compare (-p)
param.help: Comma-separated sample pairs to compare (qry,gt[,qry,gt..] with -g or qry,qry[,qry,qry..] without -g)

param.name: pairs_file
param.label: Pairs file (-P)
param.help: File with tab-delimited sample pairs to compare

param.name: use
param.label: Tags to use (-u)
param.help: Which tag to use in the query file (TAG1) and the -g file (TAG2) [PL,GT]
